title: Relational Evidence Binding Intervention, Explicit Target-Link vs Decoy-Link Control, History/Terminal Location Factorial Separation, Semantic-Twin Joint Accuracy, R/T Operator Interaction and Cross-Skin Transport Court

ancestry.gap: P63 manipulated evidence location, not explicit target-to-evidence relational binding.

design.logic: In both conditions decisive code remains the same; a target-reference relation link switches which evidence record is adjudicatively reachable. Primary synthetic ground truth is recomputed per condition and semantically audited; no claim of token-exact intervention across the binding arm.

estimands.primary: Difference in joint valid/null accuracy across target-linked versus decoy-linked, separately by physical location and lexical skin
estimands.secondary: Binding-by-location difference-in-differences; R/T operator-sign moderation is exploratory unless confirmed by preregistered sign gate
estimands.error_control: Within-skin 4-label 24^3 permutation, two-sided; Holm R/T only for operator-specific family; alpha .05
estimands.missingness: Any failed technical call yields TECHNICAL_HOLD; missingness-completion is a separate next-stage court; never treat technical failure as incorrectness
estimands.prior_art_ceiling: Black-box relational-binding sensitivity under tested synthetic archive grammar, not discovery of general relational reasoning or neural mechanism

evaluation.joint_semantics: valid requires u1,different; null requires NONE
evaluation.blinding: Original criterion frozen before any provider invocation
evaluation.strict_branch: Binding-dependent R and T opposite signs across all six matched location-skin pairs in two independent draw blocks AND Holm reject binding effects
evaluation.weaker_branch: Binding effect Holm detected without strict transport
